capabilities: Create paper notes from a DOI with metadata from OpenAlex or arXiv
Download open-access PDFs via Unpaywall into a configured folder
Query journal metrics (impact factor, JCR and CAS quartiles) from EasyScholar
Browse papers in tree and table views backed by a generated Bases file
Refresh metadata for single notes or all papers, tracking DOI changes
extras: README is written in Chinese. Unpaywall requires a caller email in settings; PDF downloads only work for open-access papers. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: 一个拥有和Zotero论文管理方式比肩的优秀视图
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up academic paper metadata from a DOI or retrieve open-access PDFs, so researchers must manage citations outside the vault.

relations.evidence: 一个拥有和Zotero论文管理方式比肩的优秀视图
输入 DOI，自动从 OpenAlex 获取标题、作者、年份、期刊
通过 arXiv API 获取 preprint 元数据（含完整摘要）
集成 Unpaywall 获取开放获取 PDF 直链
集成 EasyScholar 查询影响因子、JCR 分区、中科院分区

summary: Research paper manager that creates notes from a DOI with fetched metadata, downloads open-access PDFs, and shows papers in tree and table views.
